initialize.instructions:
RuneLite game client control for testing private servers.
Reading state:
- observe: one client-thread pass - vitals, combat, inventory, nearby NPCs/objects/items, dialogue
- get_combat_state: cheap combat poll (in combat, attackers, target, prayers, ticks since hits)
- list_npcs / list_objects / list_ground_items / get_inventory / get_dialogue answer focused questions
- get_timeline + per-channel history tools explain what just happened (projectiles, hitsplats, vars, xp, spawns, loot, overhead text)
- snapshot_state + diff_state report ONLY what changed between two points - the regression primitive
- run_batch executes an ordered list of tool calls in one request
Acting:
- list_actions: every action available now as a numbered menu; act(id) runs one - refuses stale menus
- inventory item (drop/eat/wield/use): item_action - works with the inventory tab closed
- scene object: object_action (no hover needed) or interact_object (on-screen objects)
- NPC: interact_npc, or get_npc_menu + click_menu_option for server-added options
- other player (trade/follow): interact_player; widget right-click option: widget_action
- prayer on/off: set_prayer; raw escape hatch: invoke_menu_action
Waiting: wait_for blocks until a condition is met (idle, arrival, npc death, dialogue, interface,
chat, hitsplat, projectile, animation, var, combat) - never poll with screenshots or repeated calls.
Only call screenshot when the user explicitly asks to SEE something or for visual layout verification.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG of the game canvas. No args = full canvas. Crop with componentId (single widget), interfaceId (whole interface, tight), or x/y/width/height (region).

componentId.description: Packed component id to crop to (interfaceId << 16 | childId)

childIndex.description: Dynamic child index of componentId to crop to

interfaceId.description: Interface (group) id to crop to: union of its visible component bounds

padding.description: Extra pixels around the widget/interface crop (default 0)

tools.name: get_widget
tools.description: Get a widget's values by packed component id: bounds, relative/original position, text, item, sprite, hidden state and children.

depth.description: How many levels of dynamic children to include (default 1, max 5)

tools.name: dump_interface
tools.description: Dump every component of an interface with positions/sizes/text. Call twice and diff the JSON to spot layout changes.

tools.name: list_interfaces
tools.description: List interface (group) ids currently loaded and visible, so you know what can be inspected.

tools.name: get_widget_at
tools.description: Find the deepest visible widget at a canvas pixel: its packed component id, bounds, text etc plus the parent chain. Use to identify what is at a spot on a screenshot.

tools.name: set_widget
tools.description: Live-edit a widget client-side and revalidate: move, resize, hide, retext, recolor etc. Great for prototyping interface layout changes before touching server code. Server scripts may overwrite the change on the next interface update.

componentId.description: Packed component id of the widget to modify

tools.name: get_client_state
tools.description: Get game state, canvas size, resized/fixed mode, mouse position, player world position/region, run energy, weight, camera yaw/pitch/zoom and whether a right-click menu is open.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Server and session status for diagnostics: plugin version, port, uptime, tool count, game state and (when logged in) tick + player position. Use to confirm requests reach the plugin before trusting failures.

tools.name: get_combat_state
tools.description: One cheap call for whether the local player is fighting, moving or idle: hp/prayer points, ticks since a hitsplat landed on you and since one you dealt landed, inCombat (either within 8 ticks, Idle Notifier's rule), moving/animating, walk destination, the NPC you are attacking plus every NPC/player attacking you, and active prayers.

tools.name: set_prayer
tools.description: Turn a prayer on or off in ONE call, without opening the prayer tab: e.g. prayer PROTECT_FROM_MAGIC, on true. Names are RuneLite Prayer enum names (PROTECT_FROM_MISSILES, PROTECT_FROM_MELEE, EAGLE_EYE, RIGOUR...). No-op when it is already in that state. Returns the active prayers afterwards.

on.description: true to activate (default), false to deactivate

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Everything a decision loop or test reads each step, in ONE client-thread pass: tick, position, hp/prayer, run, combat state, inventory with each item's options, nearest NPCs/interactive objects/ground items, dialogue. Use instead of calling get_client_state, get_skills, get_inventory, list_* and get_dialogue separately.

maxDistance.description: Only things within this many tiles (default 15)

sections.description: Extra sections to include: equipment, skills, players, projectiles (none by default)

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: Every action available right now as a numbered menu with plain-language labels ("Attack Goblin (lvl 2, 3 tiles)", "eat Shark", dialogue options), each with the tool + args that perform it. Built for small decision models that pick from a list. Run one with act(id). While a dialogue options menu is open, only its options are listed.

maxDistance.description: Only things within this many tiles (default 15)

dedupe.description: Keep only the nearest of identical actions, e.g. one 'Attack Goblin' (default true)

includeObservation.description: Also return the observe snapshot the menu was built from

tools.name: act
tools.description: Run action `id` from the last list_actions menu. Fails if that menu is older than maxAgeTicks, and re-validates the target right before acting (NPC identity, object still on its tile, ground item still there, dialogue still open) so a stale choice never runs. Optional args are merged into the stored call - needed for enter_input (text).

maxAgeTicks.description: Refuse menus older than this many game ticks (default 3)

args.description: Optional overrides merged into the stored tool args (e.g. text for enter_input)

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Local player skills: level, boosted level and xp per skill, plus total level. Hitpoints boosted level = current HP.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click at canvas coordinates by dispatching real mouse events.

tools.name: click_component
tools.description: Click the center of a widget resolved by packed component id. Fails if the widget is missing or hidden.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Move the mouse to canvas coordinates or a widget's center without clicking.

componentId.description: Packed component id to hover (used instead of x/y)

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Press at the source, drag through intermediate points, release at the target. Source/target are either packed component ids or canvas coordinates.

fromComponentId.description: Packed component id to drag from

fromChildIndex.description: Optional dynamic child index for the source

fromX.description: Source canvas x (used if fromComponentId absent)

toComponentId.description: Packed component id to drag to

toChildIndex.description: Optional dynamic child index for the target

toX.description: Target canvas x (used if toComponentId absent)

stepDelayMs.description: Delay between drag moves in ms (default 20)

tools.name: type_chat
tools.description: Type text into the game chatbox by dispatching key events, then press Enter to send. Works for :: commands.

text.description: Text to type into the chatbox, e.g. a chat message or a :: command

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a single key on the game canvas (e.g. ESCAPE to close an interface).

key.description: Single character, or ENTER, ESCAPE, SPACE, TAB, BACKSPACE, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, F1-F12

tools.name: walk_to
tools.description: Click the tile at world coordinates to walk there. Clicks the viewport when the tile is on screen, otherwise the minimap. Tile must be in the loaded scene.

tools.name: list_npcs
tools.description: List NPCs with id, index, name, combat level, actions, world location, distance, animation, facing, health (when visible) and canvas position, sorted by distance.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on NPC name

maxDistance.description: Only NPCs within this many tiles of the player

tools.name: list_players
tools.description: List players with name, combat level, world location, distance, animation, facing, health (when visible) and canvas position, sorted by distance. Local player is flagged isLocal.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on player name

maxDistance.description: Only players within this many tiles of the local player

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List scene objects (game, wall, decorative, ground) with id, name, actions, world position, face direction (orientation in jau 0-2047, degrees and compass) and size, sorted by distance.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on object name

maxDistance.description: Only objects within this many tiles of the player

tools.name: list_ground_items
tools.description: List items on the floor: itemId, name, quantity, world location and distance, sorted by distance. Use pickup_item to take one.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on item name

maxDistance.description: Only items within this many tiles of the player

tools.name: pickup_item
tools.description: Invoke Take on a ground item at world coordinates. Player walks to the tile and picks it up.

x.description: World x of the tile the item is on

tools.name: list_projectiles
tools.description: List projectiles currently in flight: id, remaining cycles, start scene position and target point/actor.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Read an item container by id: every slot with itemId, name and quantity. 93=inventory, 94=worn, 95=bank; server-made containers work too.

inventoryId.description: Item container id, e.g. 93 inventory, 94 worn equipment, 95 bank

includeEmpty.description: Include empty slots as itemId -1 (default false)

tools.name: list_inventories
tools.description: List all item containers currently loaded in the client: container id, slot count and non-empty item count. Use get_inventory for contents.

tools.name: interact_npc
tools.description: Invoke a cache-defined right-click option on an NPC (default Talk-to). Only sees options from the NPC definition; for server-added or runtime menu options use get_npc_menu + click_menu_option instead.

npcName.description: Case-insensitive NPC name substring; nearest match wins (used if npcIndex absent)

option.description: Right-click menu option to invoke, e.g. Talk-to, Trade, Attack (default Talk-to)

tools.name: get_npc_menu
tools.description: Hover an NPC and read its live right-click mini-menu: every entry including server-added quick options, top entry first (index 0 = default left-click). Follow with click_menu_option.

npcName.description: Case-insensitive NPC name substring; nearest match wins

tools.name: click_menu_option
tools.description: Click an entry of the currently built mini-menu (hover something first, e.g. via get_npc_menu or hover). Invokes the entry exactly as a right-click menu click would.

option.description: Case-insensitive substring of the menu option text, e.g. Vote, Trade, Quick-start

target.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of the entry target to disambiguate

tools.name: item_action
tools.description: Right-click an inventory item and click an option in ONE call - no screenshot needed. Finds the item slot, hovers it, invokes the matching menu entry (e.g. Drop). Inventory tab must be visible.

itemName.description: Case-insensitive item name substring (used if itemId absent)

option.description: Right-click option to invoke, e.g. Drop, Eat, Wield, Use, Bury

tools.name: interact_object
tools.description: Interact with a scene object in ONE call - no screenshot needed. Finds the nearest matching object, hovers it and clicks the option. e.g. nameFilter 'tree' + option 'Chop down'. list_objects shows available actions.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive object name substring; nearest match wins (used if objectId absent)

option.description: Menu option to click, e.g. Chop down, Mine, Bank, Open. Default: the object's first action

tools.name: object_action
tools.description: Invoke a scene object's option directly at its world coordinates - the object need not be on screen and the mouse never moves. Same menu entry the client sends (scene x/y + object id). Use interact_object instead when you want a real hover+click.

objectId.description: Object id from list_objects or observe

x.description: World x of the object's tile

y.description: World y of the object's tile

option.description: Menu option to invoke, e.g. Chop down, Bank, Open

tools.name: interact_player
tools.description: Interact with another player in ONE call - no screenshot needed. Hovers the player and clicks the matching right-click option, e.g. Trade with.

playerName.description: Case-insensitive player name substring; nearest match wins

option.description: Menu option to click, e.g. Trade with, Follow, Challenge, Attack

tools.name: widget_action
tools.description: Right-click any widget and click a menu option in ONE call: hovers the widget, then invokes the matching mini-menu entry. Works for spells, prayers, equipment, buttons.

componentId.description: Packed component id of the widget

option.description: Case-insensitive substring of the menu option to invoke

tools.name: invoke_menu_action
tools.description: Low-level escape hatch: invoke client.menuAction with raw parameters. Use only when the higher-level interact tools cannot express the action (params visible in get_npc_menu entries or script history).

param0.description: Menu param0 (often slot or scene x)

param1.description: Menu param1 (often packed widget id or scene y)

type.description: MenuAction enum name, e.g. CC_OP, WIDGET_TARGET, GAME_OBJECT_FIRST_OPTION

identifier.description: Menu identifier (op index, npc index, object id...)

tools.name: get_dialogue
tools.description: Read the current dialogue state: NPC/player dialogue text and speaker, numbered options menu, message box, item dialog, or open chatbox input prompt.

tools.name: continue_dialogue
tools.description: Press space to advance the current dialogue and return the new dialogue state as soon as it changes.

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Choose a numbered dialogue option by pressing its number key and return the new dialogue state as soon as it changes.

option.description: Option number as shown by get_dialogue (1-based)

tools.name: enter_input
tools.description: Type a value into the open chatbox input (string or amount prompt) and press Enter, then return the new dialogue state.

text.description: Value to type: a string or a number depending on the prompt

tools.name: get_script_history
tools.description: Report clientscripts fired recently: per-script fire counts plus individual events with game tick, timestamp and root-script arguments.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 5000)

tools.name: get_var_history
tools.description: Report varbit, varp and varc changes in a recent window, in order, with old and new values, game tick and timestamp.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 5000)

type.description: Filter: varbit, varp, varcint or varcstr

tools.name: get_var
tools.description: Read the current value of a varbit, varp, varc int or varc string.

type.description: One of: varbit, varp, varcint, varcstr

tools.name: get_projectile_history
tools.description: Report projectiles launched recently: id, start position, slope/height values, cycles and target, one entry per projectile.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

tools.name: get_effect_history
tools.description: Report animations and graphics (spotanims) played by NPCs/players recently, with actor name, npc id, value and game tick.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

actorName.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the actor name

tools.name: get_chat_history
tools.description: Read chatbox messages received recently: type, sender, message, game tick and timestamp. Covers game messages, public/private chat etc (not NPC dialogue - use get_dialogue).

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 60000)

type.description: Filter by ChatMessageType name, e.g. GAMEMESSAGE, PUBLICCHAT, PRIVATECHAT, SPAM

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the sender name

tools.name: get_combat_history
tools.description: Report hitsplats applied recently: damage amount, hitsplat type, the actor hit, its remaining health ratio and game tick. Use this for max hit, accuracy and splash checks instead of watching damage numbers on screen.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

actorName.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the actor name

tools.name: get_xp_history
tools.description: Report experience gains recently: skill, xp gained, new total xp, level and boosted level, with game tick. Use to check xp per action against the expected rate.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 60000)

skill.description: Only this skill, e.g. ATTACK, WOODCUTTING

tools.name: get_container_history
tools.description: Report item container changes recently as per-item deltas (was, now, delta), so you can see exactly what was gained, consumed or dropped and on which tick. 93 inventory, 94 worn, 95 bank.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 60000)

tools.name: get_sound_history
tools.description: Report sound effects played recently: sound id, source actor, and for area sounds the scene position, with game tick.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Every recorded channel merged into one tick-ordered stream: vars, projectiles, effects, chat, combat, experience, containers and sounds. Scripts fire many times a second, so they are left out unless requested via channels. Read this to see what happened around an action, instead of correlating the per-channel history tools by hand.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

channels.description: Only these channels: script, var, projectile, effect, chat, combat, experience, container, sound (default all but script)

fromTick.description: Only events on or after this game tick

toTick.description: Only events on or before this game tick

tools.name: snapshot_state
tools.description: Store a labelled state snapshot (vitals, combat, inventory, equipment, skills, nearby entities). Pair with diff_state to answer 'what did that action change' without eyeballing JSON.

tools.name: diff_state
tools.description: Diff the live world against a stored snapshot_state label and return ONLY the changed fields: moved tiles, hp/prayer deltas, item and entity differences. The regression-test primitive.

maxDistance.description: Entity scan radius for both snapshots (default 15)

tools.name: run_batch
tools.description: Run a list of tool calls in order in one request: steps:[{tool,arguments}]. Stops at the first failure unless stopOnError:false. Each step reports ok + result/error text.

stopOnError.description: Abort the batch on first failed step (default true)

tools.name: get_special_attack
tools.description: Special attack state: energy percent and whether the spec bar is enabled.

tools.name: toggle_special_attack
tools.description: Toggle the special attack bar by clicking the spec orb. Returns the enabled state after the click.

tools.name: get_attack_style
tools.description: Current weapon attack style index plus the style names the combat tab offers for the wielded weapon.

tools.name: set_attack_style
tools.description: Click a combat-tab attack style by name (fuzzy, e.g. 'aggressive') or index 0-3.

tools.name: list_spells
tools.description: Spells visible in the standard spellbook: name + widget component id.

tools.name: cast_spell
tools.description: Click a spellbook spell by name (fuzzy). For on-target combat spells, cast then click the target.

tools.name: is_walkable
tools.description: Collision-map check on a world tile: raw flag bits, whether the tile is walkable, and which directions are blocked. Answers 'did the door actually block'.

tools.name: get_destination
tools.description: The world tile the local player is currently walking to, or null when idle.

tools.name: search_interfaces
tools.description: Find loaded widgets whose text contains a string (quest journals, drop logs, banks, shops). Returns component ids, groups, text.

tools.name: bank_action
tools.description: Invoke a bank op directly on a banked item (Withdraw-1/5/10/All...) or a deposited item via side:'inventory' (Deposit-1/All...) — bank must be open.

side.description: bank (default, withdraw side) or inventory (deposit side)

tools.name: get_spawn_history
tools.description: NPC lifecycle events: spawn, despawn and transform (id change at a stable index — boss phase changes). Filter by kind/name.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

tools.name: get_loot_history
tools.description: Ground-item lifecycle: spawned (drops!) and despawned events with item, quantity, tile, tick — deterministic drop-table evidence.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

tools.name: get_overhead_history
tools.description: Overhead text events ('More power!') — how many mechanics announce phase changes. Filter matches actor or text.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

tools.name: get_interface_history
tools.description: Interface (widget group) load/close events in a recent window — proves the server opened or closed a screen, with the game tick it happened on.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

tools.name: get_action_history
tools.description: Audit trail of menu options the client actually invoked (walks, clicks, tool calls): option, target, MenuAction type and raw param0/param1/identifier. This is what the server received - use it to verify a tool sent the packet you expected.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

filter.description: Matches option, target or MenuAction type

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: The menu entries currently built (whatever was hovered last): option, target, MenuAction type and raw params. Inspect before click_menu_option, or to see the real packet fields for invoke_menu_action.

tools.name: list_shop
tools.description: Items on the open shop's stock widget: slot, itemId, name, stock quantity and the ops each slot offers (Value, Buy 1/5/10/50...). Errors when no shop is open.

tools.name: shop_action
tools.description: Invoke a shop op directly on a stock item (Buy 1/5/10/50, Value) or on an inventory item shown for selling via side:'inventory' (Sell 1/5/10/50) - shop must be open.

side.description: shop (default, buy side) or inventory (sell side)

tools.name: get_trade
tools.description: Trade screen state: stage (offer/confirm/none), your offered items from the trade container, and every item widget rendered on the trade screen grouped by parent (the partner's offer shows on their side).

tools.name: trade_action
tools.description: Invoke a trade op: action 'accept'/'decline' clicks the screen's button (works on the confirm screen too), or offer/remove ops on items - itemId|itemName + option ('Offer-1','Offer-10','Remove-All') + side 'inventory' (offer, default) or 'offer' (remove).

side.description: inventory (default, offer side) or offer (remove side)

tools.name: list_worlds
tools.description: The world list the client loaded: id, player count, activity, location, types, and which is current. Needed before hop_world.

tools.name: hop_world
tools.description: Hop to a world id from list_worlds. The client logs out and reconnects - follow with wait_for world or login state.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Invoke the Logout button on the logout tab interface. The logout interface must be loaded - if not loaded this errors; open the logout tab in the client first (or use press_key with the client's logout hotkey if configured).

tools.name: list_quests
tools.description: Every quest known to the client with its state: NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS or FINISHED. Filter by name substring or state.

tools.name: item_def
tools.description: Item definition from the cache: name, note/placeholder links, stackable, members, tradeable, store price and inventory options - the ground truth for what an item id is. Optional 'param' resolves one item param key.

param.description: Optional item param key to resolve (int/str/long value)

tools.name: npc_def
tools.description: NPC definition from the cache: name, combat level, menu actions, size and transform ids (varbit-driven forms).

tools.name: object_def
tools.description: Object definition from the cache: name, menu actions, size and impostor/transform ids (objects that swap form by varbit, like doors and farming patches).

tools.name: find_path
tools.description: BFS pathfind over the loaded collision map to a world tile: returns whether it's reachable plus the exact tile path. Answers 'can the player actually get there' without walking.

maxPath.description: Return at most this many path tiles (default 200)

tools.name: get_collision_area
tools.description: Raw collision flags for a rectangle of the loaded scene - the grid walls/doors/blockers live in. Row-major [y][x] in world coordinates, with per-tile walkable/decode.

tools.name: set_camera
tools.description: Point the camera: yaw and pitch targets for deterministic screenshots of the same scene.

yaw.description: Camera yaw target 0-2047 (0 = south, 512 = west, 1024 = north, 1536 = east)

pitch.description: Camera pitch target 128-383 (lower = steeper overhead view)

tools.name: use_item
tools.description: Use an inventory item on something: 'Use' is invoked on the item, then the target's 'Use item -> target' menu entry is clicked (the same two packets a player sends). Targets: npc (npcIndex|npcName), object (objectId+x+y), player (playerName), or another inventory item (targetItemId|targetItemName). For quests, crafting, keys-on-doors.

npcName.description: Use on nearest matching NPC name

targetItemId.description: Use on this inventory item id (item-on-item)

targetItemName.description: Use on this inventory item name

tools.name: compare_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot diffing for rendering regressions: first call with a label stores the region as the baseline; later calls diff against it and report changedPixels, percent and a bounding box. Same crop args as screenshot (componentId/childIndex, interfaceId, or x/y/width/height - defaults to full canvas). thresholdPct makes 'match' a pass/fail gate.

rebaseline.description: Overwrite the stored baseline instead of comparing

tools.name: widget_op
tools.description: Invoke a named widget action directly (no mouse): resolves the widget, finds option in its actions list (or opIndex position), and fires CC_OP. Use for buttons/list rows/item ops anywhere a widget exposes actions. Returns the action invoked.

componentId.description: Packed component id of the widget (or its container)

childIndex.description: Dynamic-child index inside the container (e.g. list row / item slot)

option.description: Case-insensitive substring of the action to fire, e.g. 'Wear'

opIndex.description: Fire the Nth action (0-based) instead of matching by name

tools.name: get_actor
tools.description: Deep inspect one actor by npcIndex, npcName or playerName: position, animations, facing, health, overhead text, target, spot anims, canvas position, and NPC id/composition.

tools.name: get_tile
tools.description: Inspect a single world tile: all objects (game/wall/decorative/ground) with actions, ground items, collision flags and walkability. Cheaper and more precise than list_* for a known tile.

tools.name: set_var
tools.description: Write a client-side var (varp/varbit/varcint/varcstr) for UI/state testing. CLIENT-SIDE ONLY: the server will overwrite it on the next sync; get_var.serverValue exposes what the server last sent. Returns old->new.

value.description: New value (integer for all but varcstr)

tools.name: toggle_run
tools.description: Toggle run mode by clicking the run orb. Returns energy and run state after the click.

tools.name: mark_tile
tools.description: Draw a persistent highlighted tile in the game scene so a human watching the client can see what an agent is pointing at. Optional label, colour and tick expiry.

ticks.description: Auto-remove after N game ticks (default 120; 0 = never)

tools.name: mark_widget
tools.description: Draw a persistent rectangle around a widget so a human can see which component an agent is referencing.

childIndex.description: Dynamic-child index to mark instead of the whole widget

ticks.description: Auto-remove after N game ticks (default 120; 0 = never)

tools.name: clear_marks
tools.description: Remove overlay markers: one by name, or all when name is omitted.

tools.name: get_hint_arrow
tools.description: Current hint arrow (server-set navigation marker): type + target tile/NPC/player. Servers send these for quests and mechanics.

tools.name: set_hint_arrow
tools.description: Set a client-side hint arrow on a tile, NPC or player — navigation aid for humans watching the client (server can overwrite it).

x.description: World x for a tile arrow

y.description: World y for a tile arrow

tools.name: clear_hint_arrow
tools.description: Clear the current hint arrow.

tools.name: examine
tools.description: Send an Examine packet: npcIndex/npcName, objectId+x+y, ground item (itemId+x+y), or inventory itemId — the server responds with chat text; read it via wait_for chat_message or get_chat_history.

objectId.description: Scene object id to examine (needs x/y)

itemId.description: Item id: inventory item when x/y omitted, ground item at x,y when present

tools.name: get_clan
tools.description: Clan channel info: own + guest channel name, member list (name, rank, world).

tools.name: get_fc
tools.description: Friends chat: owner, channel name, your rank, kick rank, member list (name, world, rank).

tools.name: list_friends
tools.description: Friends list: name + world for each friend.

tools.name: list_ignore
tools.description: Ignore list: names (and previous names) of ignored players.

tools.name: list_vars
tools.description: Bulk var dump: varps (with serverValue) or varcs in an id range. For 'which vars did the server just send' — pair with get_var_history for per-change evidence.

end.description: Last id to include (default: whole varp array / populated varcs)

tools.name: enum_def
tools.description: EnumComposition cache dump: enum id -> key/value rows (ints or strings). Useful for varbit-driven lookups (prayer lists, shop stock tables, skill data).

tools.name: struct_def
tools.description: StructComposition cache dump: struct id -> param keys, optionally resolving values for given keys.

keys.description: Comma-separated param keys to resolve (default: first 20 found)

tools.name: anim_def
tools.description: Animation definition: frame count, duration, per-frame lengths, forced hand items — verify an animation id does what the server intended.

tools.name: list_gfx
tools.description: Active unattached graphics objects (ground-targeted spotanims — AoE telegraphs without an actor): id, world tile, plane, finished.

tools.name: list_ge_offers
tools.description: Grand Exchange offer slots: state, itemId, quantity, sold, price, spent. Empty on servers without GE.

tools.name: get_instance_map
tools.description: Instanced region layout: isInInstancedRegion + the instance chunk template grid (source region coords + rotation per chunk) — for dungeon/instanced-area servers.

tools.name: db_table
tools.description: DBTable cache access: 'table' lists row ids, 'row' dumps a row's fields, 'table'+'column'+'value' queries rows by value. Server-driven config/data tables.

table.description: DBTable id - list its rows (or query with column+value)

value.description: Query rows whose column field equals this (int or string)

tools.name: item_sprite
tools.description: Render an item's inventory icon as a PNG image (content image block) - the same icon the client draws.

tools.name: get_music
tools.description: Active MIDI requests: archive ids + jingle flag - which music tracks/jingles the server is currently playing.

tools.name: get_object_history
tools.description: Scene object lifecycle events: spawned/despawned for game/wall/decorative/ground objects - boss arena objects, doors toggling, phase structures. Filter e.g. field=kind contains=spawned, or field=name contains=door.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

field.description: Entry field to filter on (default: return all)

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring the field must contain

tools.name: get_gfx_history
tools.description: Unattached graphics object spawns (ground spotanims - AoE telegraphs). Filter e.g. field=gfxId.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

field.description: Entry field to filter on (default: return all)

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring the field must contain

tools.name: get_interact_history
tools.description: Actor target changes: which actor targeted/cleared which target - tank swaps, retargets. Fields: source, target, sourceType, targetType.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

field.description: Entry field to filter on (default: return all)

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring the field must contain

tools.name: get_social_history
tools.description: Clan channel + friends chat events: joins, leaves, member changes. Fields: kind, name, detail.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

field.description: Entry field to filter on (default: return all)

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring the field must contain

tools.name: get_world_history
tools.description: World/session events: world_changed, mapload (instanced region loads). Fields: kind, worldId.

sinceMs.description: Window in ms (default 60000)

field.description: Entry field to filter on (default: return all)

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring the field must contain

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Block until a game condition is met, checked every 100ms - returns the moment it happens. Use this after walk_to/interact/attack instead of taking screenshots or guessing delays. Event-based conditions only see NEW events since the call started. Returns met:false with current state on timeout.

condition.description: What to wait for: idle, at_tile, npc_dead, dialogue, interface_open / interface_closed, chat_message, hitsplat, projectile, animation, spotanim, var, in_combat / out_of_combat, prayer, ticks, spawn / despawn / transform, loot, overhead, xp, container, action, world, stat, menu, game_state, object_spawn / object_despawn, interacting, gfx, hintarrow

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this long (default 10000, max 60000)

range.description: at_tile: max tiles away to count as arrived (default 1)

textContains.description: chat_message: case-insensitive substring to watch for

animationId.description: animation: exact animation id to wait for

projectileId.description: projectile: exact projectile (gfx) id to wait for

type.description: var: varbit, varp, varcint or varcstr

value.description: var: value to wait for (exact match; omit to wait for ANY change from baseline)

prayer.description: prayer: Prayer enum name, e.g. PROTECT_FROM_MAGIC

on.description: prayer: wait for active (default true) or inactive

skill.description: xp/stat: skill name, e.g. ATTACK (stat waits for any boosted/real level change)

amount.description: xp: xp gained to wait for (default 1)

itemId.description: container: item id whose count change to wait for

gfxId.description: gfx: graphics object id to match
